prepared_by: Codex coordinator; report-only candidate awaiting independent review and guarded installation
scope: Frozen Round 120 cohort of 16 existing records. This successor summarizes retained evidence and already reviewed conservative corrections; it is not new discovery, a new all-page paper review, scientific approval, or goal completion.

supersedes_without_overwriting.reason: The 113300 reports reintroduced unsupported analytical methods, catalog details, table attribution, a wrong refinement statistic, and premature final-review claims. They remain historical observations and must not be treated as current scientific assurance.

evidence_boundary: Citations and qualifiers below come from the existing independently reviewed source-fidelity work and the captured record inputs. Source file hashes were rechecked during preparation. This report does not repeat or expand assays, formulas, measurements, catalog inventories, or unreviewed mechanism derivations.

records.primary_citation: Wise WS (1982), Strontiojoaquinite and bario-orthojoaquinite: two new members of the joaquinite group, American Mineralogist 67:809-816.
records.retained_scope_qualifier: Keep the bario-orthojoaquinite column separate from the other species in Table 1.

records.primary_citation: Ehlmann AJ and Mitchell RS (1970), Behoite, beta-Be(OH)2, from the Rode Ranch pegmatite, Llano County, Texas, American Mineralogist 55:1-9.
records.retained_scope_qualifier: Preserve the semiquantitative character of the analysis and the differing abstract/text thermal descriptions; do not assert uncharacterized reaction products.

records.primary_citation: Boggs RC (1988), Calciohilairite, CaZrSi3O9·3H2O, the calcium analogue of hilairite from the Golden Horn batholith, northern Washington, American Mineralogist 73:1191-1194.
records.retained_scope_qualifier: Preserve the probable space-group assignment and the analytical distinctions between reported values and missing results.

records.primary_citation: White JS Jr, Henderson EP, and Mason B (1967), Secondary minerals produced by weathering of the Wolf Creek meteorite, American Mineralogist 52:1190-1197.
records.retained_scope_qualifier: Distinguish the chemical-analysis prose from the powder-diffraction table; the density estimate is inferred rather than directly measured.

records.primary_citation: Young EJ, Weeks AD, and Meyrowitz R (1966), Coconinoite, a new uranium mineral from Utah and Arizona, American Mineralogist 51:651-663.

records.primary_citation: Dunn PJ, Peacor DR, Erd RC, and Ramik RA (1986), Franciscanite and örebroite, two new minerals from California and Sweden, related to redefined welinite, American Mineralogist 71:1522-1526.
